title: OT behaviour baseline
description: Learned normal behaviour for the OT network: the assets seen, the pairs that talk, and the protocol function codes each service uses. Behaviour-baseline rules (rules/baseline) flag events that deviate from it.

generated_from.description: Inputs the baseline was built from, as repository-relative paths.

assets.description: Every IP address observed as a source or destination.

functions.description: Protocol function codes observed per service.
